verses.1: For the leader. For the sons of Korah. A song.
verses.2: All the nations, clap your hands. Shout to God with a voice of joy.
verses.3: For the LORD is the Most High, awesome. A great king over all the earth.
verses.4: He has subjected peoples to us, and nations beneath our feet.
verses.5: He has chosen our inheritance for us, the beauty of Jacob, whom he loves. Selah.
verses.6: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a horn.
verses.7: Sing to God, sing. Sing to our king, sing.
verses.8: For God is king over all the earth. Sing wisely.
verses.9: God has reigned over the nations. God is seated on his holy throne.
verses.10: The leaders of the peoples have gathered, the people of God Abraham, for the might of the earth is truly mighty.

notes:
Notes
- v. 2: “All the nations, clap your hands” is a direct rendering of כָּל־הָעַמִּים תִּקְעוּ־כָף, which uses תִּקְעוּ from the root קָפָה (to strike).
- v. 5: “the beauty of Jacob” is a poetic rendering of אֶת גְּאוֹן יַעֲקֹב, where גְּאוֹן can mean "beauty," "glory," or "pride." The context suggests "beauty" as a poetic term for inheritance.
- v. 10: “for the might of the earth is truly mighty” reflects the Hebrew’s use of מְאֹד נַעֲלָה, which is a superlative expression.
